```{r setup, include=FALSE}
## No YAML frontmatter: this file is `{{< include >}}`d into manuscript/01_manuscript.qmd,
## and any YAML here either breaks it. 
## 
## Render standalone with: quarto render qmd/01_table1.qmd --to html --embed-resources
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(tidyverse)
    library(here)
    library(gt)
    library(arrow)
    library(duckdb)
})
source(here::here("code", "utils.R"))

main_ci <- arrow::read_parquet(
    here::here("data", "summaries", "main_ci.parquet")
) |>
    dplyr::filter(geography == "national") |>
    dplyr::select(component, mean, p025, p975)

part_ci <- arrow::read_parquet(
    here::here("data", "summaries", "partition_ci.parquet")
) |>
    dplyr::filter(geography == "national") |>
    dplyr::select(component, mean, p025, p975)

get_ci <- function(df, comp) {
    row <- df |> dplyr::filter(component == comp)
    list(mean = row$mean, lower = row$p025, upper = row$p975)
}

rate_a <- get_ci(main_ci, "rate_a")
rate_b <- get_ci(main_ci, "rate_b")
crude_d <- get_ci(main_ci, "delta_rate")
vmt_e <- get_ci(main_ci, "vmt_effect")
risk_e <- get_ci(main_ci, "risk_effect")
risk_total <- risk_e$mean

n_iter_table1 <- max(arrow::read_parquet(
    here::here("data", "summaries", "main_ci.parquet")
)$n)
n_all_bins   <- length(return_all_bins())
n_behavioral <- length(return_behavioral_flagged())
n_nonself    <- length(return_nonself_driven())

pct_of <- function(x, total) {
    100 * x / total
}
```

```{r panel-a-data}
panel_a <- tibble::tibble(
    Population = "Total",
    `2021 rate (95% UI)` = fmt_rate_ci(rate_a$mean, rate_a$lower, rate_a$upper),
    `2024 rate (95% UI)` = fmt_rate_ci(rate_b$mean, rate_b$lower, rate_b$upper),
    `Rate change (95% UI)` = fmt_val_ci(crude_d$mean, crude_d$lower, crude_d$upper),
    `% change` = fmt_pct(100 * crude_d$mean / rate_a$mean)
)
```

```{r panel-b-data}
## HTML collapses runs of ASCII spaces; use non-breaking spaces so gt
## preserves the visible indentation in both HTML and DOCX output. Note that
## in RStudio this sometimes results in a weird red highlighted character. 
INDENT2 <- strrep("\u00a0", 4)
INDENT4 <- strrep("\u00a0", 8)

bin_row <- function(label, comp) {
    ci <- get_ci(part_ci, comp)
    tibble::tibble(
        Component = paste0(INDENT4, label),
        `Contribution to rate change (95% UI)` = fmt_val_ci(ci$mean, ci$lower, ci$upper),
        `% of per-mile risk component` = fmt_pct(pct_of(ci$mean, risk_total))
    )
}

panel_b_top <- tibble::tibble(
    Component = c(
        "Total crude rate change",
        paste0(INDENT2, "VMT component"),
        paste0(INDENT2, "Per-mile risk component")
    ),
    `Contribution to rate change (95% UI)` = c(
        fmt_val_ci(crude_d$mean, crude_d$lower, crude_d$upper),
        fmt_val_ci(vmt_e$mean, vmt_e$lower, vmt_e$upper),
        fmt_val_ci(risk_e$mean, risk_e$lower, risk_e$upper)
    ),
    `% of per-mile risk component` = c("—", "—", fmt_pct(100))
)

behavioral_bins <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    bin_row("Speed-only", "speed_only_contrib"),
    bin_row("Alcohol-only", "alc_only_contrib"),
    bin_row("Unrestrained-only", "unr_only_contrib"),
    bin_row("Speed and Alcohol", "speed_alc_contrib"),
    bin_row("Speed and Unrestrained", "speed_unr_contrib"),
    bin_row("Alcohol and Unrestrained", "alc_unr_contrib"),
    bin_row("All three flagged", "all_three_contrib")
)

other_bins <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    bin_row("Pedestrian", "ped_contrib"),
    bin_row("Bicyclist", "bike_contrib"),
    bin_row("Other (truck/bus/ATV/etc.)", "other_nonpv_contrib")
)

## Behavioral subtotal covers only the 7 flagged bins; none_flagged is a
## self-driven death with no flagged behavior and is shown as its own row.
behavioral_cols <- unname(return_bin_map()[return_behavioral_flagged()])
other_cols <- c(
    "ped_contrib",
    "bike_contrib",
    "other_nonpv_contrib"
)

## Subtotal CIs come from the raw partition sims: sum per simulation
## iteration first, then take mean / 2.5th / 97.5th percentiles.
sum_ci_for_components <- function(component_names) {
    con <- duckdb::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb(), read_only = TRUE)
    on.exit(duckdb::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE), add = TRUE)

    sims <- dplyr::tbl(
        con,
        sprintf(
            "read_parquet('%s')",
            here::here("temp_output", "simulations", "partition", "*.parquet")
        )
    )

    sims |>
        dplyr::filter(
            geography == "national",
            component %in% component_names
        ) |>
        dplyr::group_by(batch_id, sim_id) |>
        dplyr::summarise(sum_value = sum(value), .groups = "drop") |>
        dplyr::collect() |>
        dplyr::summarise(
            mean = mean(sum_value),
            lower = stats::quantile(sum_value, 0.025),
            upper = stats::quantile(sum_value, 0.975)
        )
}

behavioral_ci <- sum_ci_for_components(behavioral_cols)
none_ci <- get_ci(part_ci, "none_contrib")
other_ci <- sum_ci_for_components(other_cols)

## Additivity: the 7 behavioral bins + none-flagged + 3 other-road-user bins
## reconstruct the per-mile risk effect.
stopifnot(
    abs((behavioral_ci$mean + none_ci$mean + other_ci$mean) - risk_total) < 1e-6
)

empty_row <- tibble::tibble(
    Component = "",
    `Contribution to rate change (95% UI)` = "",
    `% of per-mile risk component` = ""
)

risk_components_header <- tibble::tibble(
    Component = "Per-mile risk components",
    `Contribution to rate change (95% UI)` = "",
    `% of per-mile risk component` = ""
)

behavioral_subtotal <- tibble::tibble(
    Component = paste0(INDENT2, "Behavioral risk factors"),
    `Contribution to rate change (95% UI)` = fmt_val_ci(
        behavioral_ci$mean, behavioral_ci$lower, behavioral_ci$upper
    ),
    `% of per-mile risk component` = fmt_pct(pct_of(behavioral_ci$mean, risk_total))
)

none_subtotal <- tibble::tibble(
    Component = paste0(INDENT2, "No behavioral risk factor flagged"),
    `Contribution to rate change (95% UI)` = fmt_val_ci(
        none_ci$mean, none_ci$lower, none_ci$upper
    ),
    `% of per-mile risk component` = fmt_pct(pct_of(none_ci$mean, risk_total))
)

other_subtotal <- tibble::tibble(
    Component = paste0(INDENT2, "Other road users"),
    `Contribution to rate change (95% UI)` = fmt_val_ci(
        other_ci$mean, other_ci$lower, other_ci$upper
    ),
    `% of per-mile risk component` = fmt_pct(pct_of(other_ci$mean, risk_total))
)

panel_b <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    panel_b_top,
    empty_row,
    risk_components_header,
    behavioral_subtotal,
    behavioral_bins,
    none_subtotal,
    other_subtotal,
    other_bins
)
```

```{r}
#| tbl-cap: !expr sprintf("Kitagawa decomposition of the change in US motor vehicle mortality rate from 2021 to 2024. The total rate change is partitioned into a vehicle miles traveled (VMT) component and a per-mile risk component. The per-mile risk component is further partitioned into %d mutually exclusive bins (%d behavioral; 1 with no behavioral flag; %d other road-user groups). FARS death counts and US Census Bureau population estimates were used to calculate crude mortality rates. VMT data came from the Federal Highway Administration (FHWA). 95%% uncertainty intervals were obtained using Monte Carlo simulation of %s iterations and the percentile method.", n_all_bins, n_behavioral, n_nonself, format(n_iter_table1, big.mark = ","))

bold_idx <- which(
    panel_b$Component %in% c(
        "Total crude rate change",
        "Per-mile risk components"
    )
)
italic_idx <- which(
    panel_b$Component %in% c(
        paste0(INDENT2, "Behavioral risk factors"),
        paste0(INDENT2, "No behavioral risk factor flagged"),
        paste0(INDENT2, "Other road users")
    )
)

gt::gt(panel_b) |>
    gt::tab_style(
        style = gt::cell_text(weight = "bold"),
        locations = gt::cells_body(rows = bold_idx)
    ) |>
    gt::tab_style(
        style = gt::cell_text(style = "italic"),
        locations = gt::cells_body(rows = italic_idx)
    ) |>
    gt::cols_align(align = "right", columns = -1) |>
    gt::cols_align(align = "left", columns = 1)
```

```{r write-csv}
readr::write_csv(panel_b, here::here("output", "table1.csv"))
```
